instruction: Cinematic film still, medium full shot. Inside a spacious classical hall with polished wooden floors and white columns, the man in the brown shirt and beanie (R1) stands in the center, lifting the woman in the black dress (R2) in a horizontal cradle carry. The man (R1) looks up at her with a focused expression while supporting her body, and the woman (R2), wearing a white ribbon in her hair, looks down at him. Soft, natural light from large windows illuminates the scene, creating a warm, intimate atmosphere.
